privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Absouts ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services. Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the site.

We reserve the right to make changes to this Privacy Policy at any time and for any reason. We will alert you about any changes by updating the Last Updated date of this Privacy Policy. You are encouraged to periodically review this Privacy Policy to stay informed of updates.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect personally identifiable information that you voluntarily provide to us when you register on the website, express interest in our products or services, participate in website activities, or contact us through forms or email.
The personal information we collect may include name and contact data, professional information, communication data, marketing preferences, and interests.

When you visit our website, we may automatically collect IP address, browser type, operating system, device information, pages visited, time spent on pages, navigation paths, referring websites, cookies, and similar tracking technologies.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use the information we collect to provide, operate, and maintain our services, respond to inquiries, provide customer support, send technical notices and administrative messages, communicate about products and services, analyze usage trends, improve our website, address security threats, comply with legal obligations, enforce our terms, process transactions, and manage accounts.

sections.title: Disclosure of Your Information
paragraphs: We may share your information with service providers who perform services on our behalf, in connection with business transfers, when legally required, or when necessary to protect vital interests and legal rights, investigate policy violations, prevent fraud, address safety concerns, or support litigation.

sections.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect personal information. However, no electronic transmission over the internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.
We maintain security measures including encryption, secure servers, access controls, and regular security assessments to protect data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy. We also retain and use information as needed to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce policies, and analyze usage for security and service improvement.

sections.title: Your Privacy Rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, object to, restrict processing of, receive a portable copy of, or withdraw consent for your personal information. To exercise these rights, contact us using the information at the end of this policy.

sections.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our website and store certain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse cookies or indicate when a cookie is being sent, although some parts of the website may not function properly without cookies.

sections.title: Third-Party Websites
paragraphs: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites, and we encourage you to read their privacy policies.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our services are not directed to individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If we learn that we collected such information without verified parental consent, we will take steps to remove it from our servers.

sections.title: International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Your information may be transferred to and maintained on computers outside your state, province, country, or jurisdiction. We will take necessary steps to ensure your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your privacy rights, contact Absouts at support@absouts.com, by phone at +880 1234 567 890, or at our office in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
